[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended alternative toppings for overnight oats instead of nuts:  
- Fresh or dried fruits  
- Seeds (chia seeds, flaxseeds)  
- Coconut flakes  
- Cinnamon, vanilla, or cocoa powder  
- Honey, maple syrup, or fruit preserves  
- Creamy toppings (Greek yogurt, peanut butter, sunflower seed butter)  
- Other options (tahini, hemp seed butter, shredded coconut, dark chocolate)  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the idea of adding seeds like chia or flaxseeds to overnight oats.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a simple recipe for basic overnight oats with chia seeds:  
- 1/2 cup rolled oats  
- 1/2 cup unsweetened almond milk or milk of choice  
- 1 tablespoon chia seeds  
- 1 tablespoon honey or maple syrup (optional)  
- Pinch of salt  
- Toppings (sliced banana, berries, shredded coconut, cinnamon)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided instructions for making overnight oats.  
[PREFERENCE] User is thinking of trying the flaxseeds version of overnight oats.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained how to grind flaxseeds using different methods:  
- Coffee grinder  
- Blender  
- Food processor  
- Mortar and pestle  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised to grind flaxseeds just before using them to avoid rancidity.
